statement: Pinned xone decodes the standard gamepad GIP input payload into face buttons, menu/view, bumpers, stick clicks, two analog triggers, two signed sticks and a D-pad hat. Share is advertised only when a matching interface identifier appears; its source byte is counted from the end of the report with a conditional extension adjustment. The Guide button arrives through a separate internal virtual-key command and is exposed as BTN_MODE.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series where applicable; xone GIP class path also supports other compatible models
applicability.scope: driver/gamepad.c:33-106, 260-299, 335-415, 469-482; bus/protocol.c:1320-1344. Applies to GIP client decoding behind wired or receiver transports. No physical Series report is measured.
